name: source-arrow-fields
goal: Exclude typed callback declarations from executable source blocks and complexity.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Independent review ran real sourceBlocks on pinned Workspace blobs and found callback declarations parsed as executable properties, double-counting later decisions. The current property matcher treats the equals of a type arrow as initialization and scans beyond a nested type. Preserve real initialized arrow fields.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Extend existing test/utils/source-blocks.test.ts with callback declarations, initialized fields and typed/generic function annotations. Assert exact named blocks and complexity; current tests cover normal functions, methods and Svelte regions but omit typed callback fields.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Valid committed red b72afcad7 record a9ff4e5f73da fails three standard syntax cases and retains28 canonical measurements; the complete test and configuration corpus is frozen.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The ca327dcdd fix finds actual declaration-depth assignments, skips arrows in type annotations and generic defaults, and inspects only the initializer. Existing initialized callback behavior remains covered.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired red b72afcad7 record a9ff4e5f73da and green ca327dcdd record aa60958d0caf used unchanged tests/configuration and identical profile1008f686. Seven cases pass;28 measurements per phase read back successfully. Earlier noncanonical benchmark drafts grant no proof.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
